data.opportunityTitle: National Services for State Arts Agencies and Regional Arts Organizations

synopsis.agencyContactDesc:
NEA State and Regional Partnerships
NEAStateRegional@arts.gov
synopsis.synopsisDesc:
Funding is available to support national services and activities that benefit State Arts Agencies (SAAs) and Regional Arts Organizations (RAOs). Projects may include leadership development, training, strategic planning, program coordination, information sharing, and other activities that strengthen accountability, transparency, and organizational effectiveness.

Eligibility for this grant is limited only to non-profit organizations that have a five-year history of arts programming as a membership organization with a national mission and demonstrated capacity to provide services, research, and technical assistance to all SAAs and RAOs.

applicantTypes.description: Nonprofits having a 501(c)(3) status with the IRS, other than institutions of higher education
